made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/entrada-sheet-make.js, from entrada-set.html (window.ENTRADA.E, E.SEATS) and the design of La entrada (the orchestrator's p8-spec, section entrada). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 66. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the back wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 66 + 13 v - 22.5 z. The picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 0.46: the bench's seat top; z 0.44: a chair's seat top; z 0.74: a table's top; z 0.6: the mesero's stool) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): its bottom middle is on the point. scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up, 41 for a child; abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30, rows 0 to 49; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; a grown-up or a child sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41, t 7 a child: 33) on (sx, sy); a small thing: see spot. Nobody is drawn turned: the makers draw them from the front (the two at the vellonera face us)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.waist: whole from the waist up: the top 35 rows of a grown-up's sprite, the rows above the hips (mkPersona: the hips are an ellipse round row hc = 18 + 2 t - 2 = 38, 3.4 high either side: they start at row 35); the spec gives no row: open point (the check also reports the top 38 rows, to the middle of the hips)
rules.tables: each table is 2.2 wide (THW 1.1 either side of its middle) and 1.2 deep (the chairs of the far side stand .26 beyond its far edge); the far chairs are 0.55 either side of its middle, the end chairs 1.5 (E.SEATS: the two far chairs, then the left end, then the right end)

The window's point is the ground point under its middle column at the picture's middle row

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the stand, the rope's posts, the tables and the chairs' backs, the vellonera and the bench hide whoever is behind them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El cruce's sheet: the upright plane through the feet (a held thing: the plane through its own bottom; a cloth: the plane through its hem)
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the floor (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on a chair, the bench or the stool, or stands on a table (z above 0) casts none: none of those is the floor (a shadow cast at the floor under them would show in front of them)
